# Documents: Allotment Society Kit

## Buyer
Volunteer secretaries and treasurers of a community garden or allotment society who run meetings, bill plot fees and host the yearly harvest fair, in Word or Google Docs.
- Not for: large associations with membership software.

## Promise
Every document the committee needs, ready the same evening: type the names, print or send.

## Documents
| Document | Job |
| --- | --- |
| minutes | Record a committee meeting: attendance, decisions, action points, signatures |
| invoice | Bill a member for the plot fee and extras with correct totals |
| program | Announce the harvest fair: schedule, competitions, thanks |

## Look
Theme: warm
Accent: #8A4B2D
